svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Fig. H2 — B_r round the atom on spheres of growing radius (each curve scaled to its own peak)
from the north pole (0°) to the south pole (180°); each sign change separates an N zone from an S zone
m = ½: three sign changes (four zones, N S N S) out to 15.6 a0, then one (two zones). m = 3⁄2: one sign change at every radius.
